reviewers.agent: general-purpose subagent (Claude), independent context — compared the translation to the memq reference and found increase() extrapolation/first-delta-drop, stepped bucket misalignment, gauge boundary/staleness, doc overclaim, and missing numeric-parity tests

accepted on the reviewer's prescription + reasoning — the cumulative-diff and last_over_time translations follow the review's own recommended fix; numeric parity vs a live Prometheus is inherently unverifiable in this build env and is tracked in workspace-0ka

records.finding: increase() over a cumulative counter extrapolates to boundaries and drops the first in-range delta, so it does not equal memq's exact sum-of-deltas — failing the 'same numbers' bar.
records.evidence: inner = increase(metric[range]) vs memq sum of delta Values in [From,To)
records.reason: Replaced with the exact non-extrapolating cumulative difference sum by(g)(m @ To) - sum by(g)(m @ From). Exact for monotonic counters up to sample-boundary alignment; resets/one-end-only series are documented edges tracked in workspace-0ka.

records.finding: Stepped increase() looks backward from each step boundary while memq buckets forward, shifting values one step.
records.evidence: query_range increase([Step]) vs memq forward buckets
records.reason: Stepped (Step>0) queries are now rejected with a clear error; the engine issues only Step==0. Stepped support tracked in workspace-0ka.

records.finding: Package/translate docs asserted bit-for-bit parity with memq, which increase() did not provide.
records.evidence: '...so the engine reads the same numbers from Prometheus that it reads from memq'
records.reason: Docs rewritten to state the cumulative-diff/last_over_time approach, its exactness (monotonic counters, sample-boundary alignment), and that live-backend numeric parity is verified by the golden harness (workspace-0ka).

records.finding: Gauge instant at To used Prometheus's ~5m staleness (vs memq unbounded carry-forward) and the at-or-before-To boundary.
records.evidence: at: q.Range.To with bare metric instant
records.reason: Uses last_over_time(m[window] @ To) to carry the last level forward across the whole window, matching memq's within-window carry-forward. The <To vs <=To boundary tick is documented as sample-alignment-dependent.

records.finding: No test asserted numeric parity with memq (the actual bar); only translation strings and canned parsing.
records.evidence: TestTranslate checks expr strings; integration asserts presence not value
records.reason: In-tree tests cover the new translation goldens + parsing + stepped/NaN/base fixes. True numeric parity requires a live Prometheus seeded from the harness (testcontainers), unavailable in this env — implemented as the golden-harness follow-up workspace-0ka.

records.finding: rangeQuery set end=To-1s with no guard; sub-second ranges could make end<start.
records.reason: The adapter is instant-only now (no range query); the underflow path is removed.

records.finding: strconv.ParseFloat accepted Prometheus 'NaN'/'Inf' literals, flowing a non-finite value to the engine as money.
records.reason: sample() now rejects NaN/±Inf via math.IsNaN/IsInf.

records.finding: Raw URL concatenation produced a double slash for a base with a trailing slash.
records.reason: New() trims a trailing slash from the base URL; TestBaseTrailingSlashNormalized pins it.
